'''Grass Trekkers''' were [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] predatory mammals native to the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They were aggressive and warlike, attacking any groups with whom they came in contact. On one occasion shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Grass Trekkers attacked a group of [[Gupin/Legends|Gupins]] who lived in a fortress. The Gupin [[Punt]] gave them the key to the [[Juniper Chest]], which helped rejuvenate the Gupins' shapeshifting powers. The Gupins then asked for help from the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], and together, they recaptured the key and drove the Grass Trekkers away.
